verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly describe an official MCP integration: point the API at a remote MCP server URL and Groq handles all tool orchestration without custom logic, and a dedicated official MCP docs page exists (console.groq.com/docs/mcp). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that this MCP integration works reliably in practice, and no third-party report validating the MCP connection flow.
